identification: Single photo. Two opened English booster bundle boxes (left: Pokemon TCG 30th Celebration, 'Celebrating 30 Years of Pokemon', contents look like a stack of loose cards or packs; right: Mega Evolution Ascended Heroes, 'Rise to a new challenge', sealed packs visible at the top) plus about 10 visible sleeved Simplified Chinese 30th anniversary Pikachu cards (claimed 1-30). Bundles originally hold 6 packs each; how many remain is unknown. The Chinese Pikachu set is a mass-market item, not rare.

viewing_check: Open the two boxes: count how many packs remain and whether they are sealed with foil intact (Ascended Heroes packs are the value; 6 packs per bundle originally). Check the 30th Celebration box contents are real packs not loose cards. Count the Chinese Pikachu cards (are all 30 there, any numbered 1-30 sets with matching card backs), check for fakes (print quality, holo pattern) and whether any other cards are under the sleeves.
